checks.scope: Frozen-input/after/dependency hashes; exact patch replay; function-level change scope (only init/probe/handleStart/waitResponse/enumerate changed, two functions added, poll/receive/fail/teardown/descriptor byte-identical); opt-ins before the CAS; exactly two read queries and no command 0x52/0x51/0x32, extra dlsp_request, setReport/getReport/handleReport, publishResource/registerService/notifier or child attach in changed code; preservation after the gate and never short-circuited; header include order; real extracted bodies compiled with the Grok core under ASan/UBSan (16 cases: success, every failure stage, short/oversize payloads, used key, handleStart gate failure/success/base failure, allocation/provider/instance copy failures).

interop_note: core/m1tp_enum.h leaves its two-argument M1TP_ASSERT defined, while observation_layout.h defines and undefines a one-argument one; PDM1SPIHID.h includes observation_layout.h first to avoid a redefinition. A future header revision should undefine the macro in m1tp_enum.h.
